title: Pentagon doubles down on Canada rebuke with demand for NATO spending road map, F-35 decision
desc: After publicly freezing a historic Canada-U.S. defence forum earlier this week, senior Pentagon officials sharpened their criticism Thursday, accusing Ottawa of failing to produce a credible NATO spending plan and dragging out a politically charged review of the F-35 fighter purchase, further straining bilateral relations.

title: Bungie might get hit with “a significant number” of layoffs now that Destiny 2 is wrapping up.
desc:
Employees also want to pitch and start work on new games, but Bungie hasn’t greenlit anything yet, Bloomberg reports.
Destiny 2 will get its last major update on June 9th, Bungie announced Thursday.

title: Local knowledge and science combine for wildlife conservation in Cameroon

title: Denuvo added to 007 First Light 6 days before release date, canceling pre-orders
desc: Some James Bond fans have decided to skip 007 First Light, opting to wait for the next movie. With the game’s release date on May 27th, Denuvo has surfaced on its Steam listing. Buyers concerned about performance and DRM restrictions have canceled their pre-orders.

title: Everyday plastics and fertility: What to know
desc: Chemicals in food packaging, receipts and personal care items can disrupt hormones and may impact fertility – reducing everyday exposure can help lower risks.

title: NASA's AWE instrument completes mission to study Earth's effect on space weather
desc: On May 21, ground controllers powered down NASA's AWE (Atmospheric Waves Experiment) instrument, bringing the data collection phase of the mission to a successful and scheduled end, surpassing its planned two-year mission.
